name: famulus-expertise
title: MCP server of Famulus Expertise
availability: The server runs within the publisher's network. It has no public address yet; every answer it gives is built from the files named under `static`, which are public.

tools.name: fx_about
tools.description: The series: title, publisher, editor, licence, ISSN, its task, aim and audience, the publication rules, and the quality gates every issue is measured by.
tools.returns: {series_title, url, editor, publisher, licence, issn, profile{assignment, task, aim, audience, rules[]}, gates[{gate_id, stage, titel, kriterium, sperrend}], catalogue}

tools.name: fx_series
tools.description: The sub-series (one per edition) with scope, collections, address and number of issues.

tools.name: fx_issues
tools.description: The issues, optionally of one sub-series or status; each with numbers, title, authors, version, date, address and gate verdict.

edition.description: slug of the sub-series, e.g. 'euler'; empty: all

status.description: published | revised | withdrawn; empty: all public

tools.returns: {issues[{ref, edition, number, whole_number, title, authors[], version, date, status, url, pdf, gates}]}

tools.name: fx_issue
tools.description: The complete preamble famulus-expertise/1 of one issue: identity, responsibility, subject, claims, evidence, agent context, quality, counting; with title, abstract and keywords.

ref.description: an issue: 'euler/1', 'fr:expertise/euler/1', its URL, or its whole number

tools.name: fx_text
tools.description: The running text of an issue by section (without figures and embedded segments). Without `section`: the list of sections with their numbers.

ref.description: an issue: 'euler/1', 'fr:expertise/euler/1', its URL, or its whole number

section.description: section id (e.g. 'sec-results') or section number (e.g. '4'); empty: the list

tools.returns: {found, ref, sections[{number, title, id}]} or {found, ref, section, number, title, text, cite}

tools.name: fx_search
tools.description: Full-text search (BM25) over the sections of all issues; each hit names issue, section and how to cite the place.
tools.returns: {query, hits[{ref, title, section, number, score, snippet, cite}]}

tools.name: fx_claims
tools.description: The main statements (Aussagen) of an issue, each with its status (grounded | gap), its grounds as Famulus references, and its section.

ref.description: an issue: 'euler/1', 'fr:expertise/euler/1', its URL, or its whole number

tools.returns: {found, ref, confirmed_by, claims[{id, text, section, status, grounds[], gap, contested[]}]}

tools.name: fx_references
tools.description: Every Famulus reference (fr: address) an issue uses, with its roles (segment | inline | subject | ground), plus citation keys and figures. Resolve an address with the tool fr_describe of the server famulus-reference.

ref.description: an issue: 'euler/1', 'fr:expertise/euler/1', its URL, or its whole number

tools.returns: {found, ref, references[{ref, roles[], count}], citations[], figures[], resolver}

tools.name: fx_about_source
tools.description: Which issues treat a place of a source: all issues whose references lie at, below or above the given fr: address.
tools.returns: {fr, issues[{ref, title, url, matches[{ref, roles[]}], claims[{id, text}]}]}

tools.name: fx_cite
tools.description: How to cite an issue: text form or BibTeX, always with the version; with `section` the citation of that place (an HTML page has no page numbers).

ref.description: an issue: 'euler/1', 'fr:expertise/euler/1', its URL, or its whole number

section.description: section id or number to cite a place; empty: the whole issue

tools.returns: {found, ref, version, cite, bibtex, section_cite, latex}

tools.name: fx_gates
tools.description: The run of the quality gates of an issue: catalogue version, verdict (passed | blocked | inventory), counts, and every gate that is not fulfilled with its result.

ref.description: an issue: 'euler/1', 'fr:expertise/euler/1', its URL, or its whole number

tools.returns: {found, ref, version, quality{catalogue, run, verdict, counts, open[]}, rules_url}

tools.name: fx_seal
tools.description: The quality seal of an issue: whether it is granted, its three necessary conditions (the pass through Famulus Lektor with the author's assent to thesis, premises and proof; sharp Famulus references as grounding evidence; the methodological gates), what is missing, who released the version, and the statement of the author's sole responsibility.

ref.description: an issue: 'euler/1', 'fr:expertise/euler/1', its URL, or its whole number

tools.returns: {found, ref, version, seal{granted, date, version, released_by, conditions[{id, fulfilled}], missing[]}, meaning, responsibility, rules_url}

tools.name: fx_objections
tools.description: The objections on record against an issue, with their state (received | under-examination | convincing | not-convincing | withdrawn), the author's reason, and for a convincing objection its annotation and the version since which it stands; plus how to file an objection (format famulus-objection/1).

ref.description: an issue: 'euler/1', 'fr:expertise/euler/1', its URL, or its whole number

status.description: only objections of this status; empty: all

tools.returns: {found, ref, version, objections[{id, version, point, statement, grounds[], by, status, reason, annotation}], contested_claims[], how_to_object}

resources.description: the series: profile, sub-series, issues (as fx_about + fx_issues)
the preamble of one issue (as fx_issue)

answers: JSON. What is not there is {"found": false, "gap": "<reason>"}, never an empty result. No tool calls a model.
references: Famulus references (fr: addresses) are resolved by the server famulus-reference (tool fr_describe).
